segments.name: banking operations
segments.description: Community bank lending to individuals, professionals and small to medium-sized businesses and accepting their deposits across Louisiana, Texas and Alabama markets.
segments.evidence: Management considers all of our operations to be aggregated in one reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Individuals and small to medium-sized businesses pay interest on loans and fees for loan and deposit services, with securities investments adding income.
revenueModel.evidence: Our principal business is lending to and accepting deposits from individuals and small to medium-sized businesses in our areas of operation.

changes.text: In 2023 the Company exited the consumer mortgage origination business.
changes.evidence: In the third quarter of 2023, we exited the consumer mortgage origination business.
